title: Unbuilt sites return setup state and open their existing Build tab
steps: Run the design-system site-setup route and real-plugin DOM tests.
Read an unattached fleet claim with no address for WordPress, Joomla and EmDash.
Read provisioned, attached legacy and imported sites.
Mount the real plugin over SITE_NOT_READY and press Open Build.
expect: Unbuilt sites return HTTP 200 with SITE_NOT_READY, canApply false and no container or library calls.
Provisioned and attached legacy sites still read their container; imports retain SITE_IMPORTED.
The panel explains unfinished setup without a generic read error or retry button.
Open Build requests tracy:build:wordpress with the existing site key, without apply or undo.
fence: The current site row's attachment and address prevent a reserved or reused name from triggering a container read before provision.
